title: Writing: A Complete Academic Argumentative Essay

writingModel.placeholder: Context (1-2 sentences) + precise central claim + preview of argument
writingModel.hint: "It is argued in this essay that… / This essay examines… and contends that…"

writingModel.placeholder: Topic sentence (genuine claim) + evidence + analysis linking to central argument
writingModel.hint: "This finding suggests that… / This evidence supports the claim that… / Crucially, this demonstrates…"
"It might be objected that… Admittedly… Nevertheless, this objection does not establish…"

writingModel.placeholder: Strongest supporting point with fully explicit warrant
writingModel.hint: "It has been demonstrated that… This finding is significant insofar as it shows that the warrant holds…"

writingModel.placeholder: Reaffirm claim in light of evidence + implications + limitations + future research
writingModel.hint: "In light of the above, it can be concluded that… Notably, this analysis is limited by… Future research should investigate…"

writingTemplate.prefix: It is argued in this essay that
writingTemplate.suffix: , a claim supported by a substantial body of empirical and theoretical evidence.
writingTemplate.placeholder: progressive pedagogical approaches produce better outcomes for critical thinking development
writingTemplate.hint: "It is argued that + claim" — precise academic introduction

writingTemplate.suffix: , providing strong support for this position.
writingTemplate.placeholder: a large-scale meta-analysis of 42 studies found that students in progressive classrooms consistently outperformed peers on measures of analytical reasoning

writingTemplate.suffix: . Admittedly, this objection has force. Nevertheless,
writingTemplate.placeholder: progressive approaches sacrifice content knowledge for process skills / it does not establish that both cannot be achieved simultaneously

writingTemplate.prefix: It has been demonstrated, crucially, that
writingTemplate.suffix: , which confirms the central argument of this essay.
writingTemplate.placeholder: the gains in critical thinking observed in progressive classrooms persist into higher education and professional contexts
writingTemplate.hint: "It has been demonstrated that" + explicit linking to the central argument

writingTemplate.prefix: In light of the above, it can be concluded that
writingTemplate.suffix: . Notably, this analysis is limited by the range of contexts studied; future research should investigate whether the findings generalise to non-Western educational systems.
writingTemplate.placeholder: progressive pedagogies represent a more effective approach to critical thinking development than traditional instruction
writingTemplate.hint: "In light of the above" + limitations + future research = complete academic conclusion

items: It is argued in this essay that…
This essay examines the evidence for X and contends that…
A substantial body of research suggests that…
It has been widely assumed that X; however, this essay challenges that assumption.
The central claim of this analysis is that…
This finding is significant insofar as it demonstrates that…
Crucially, this evidence establishes that the warrant between X and Y holds.
It should be noted that this correlation has been replicated across multiple contexts.
Notably, the largest studies show the strongest effects.
This pattern suggests that the relationship is not an artefact of the specific study design.
It might be objected that this evidence does not establish causation.
Admittedly, the effect sizes in some studies are small. Nevertheless, they are consistent.
To be fair, critics raise a valid methodological concern about selection bias.
Granted, the evidence is not unanimous. That said, the weight of evidence supports this interpretation.
This objection has force up to a point; however, it does not undermine the central argument.
In light of the above, it can be concluded that…
This analysis suggests, albeit tentatively, that…
Crucially, these findings have implications for how X is approached in practice.
Notably, this analysis is limited by its focus on Western educational contexts.
Future research should investigate whether these patterns hold in different cultural settings.

questions.text: "___, the meta-analysis found no significant difference between groups." (unexpected finding)
"___ ___ ___ ___ that not all of these studies used equivalent methodologies." (important to note)
questions.hint: "It should be noted that + clause" — comment clause

questions.text: "This ___ suggests that the intervention effect is not sustained long-term." (what the pattern is)
questions.hint: "This finding/pattern/result suggests that…" — all are valid "this + summary noun" patterns

questions.text: "___ ___ ___ ___, it can be concluded that progressive pedagogies are more effective." (given what was discussed)
questions.hint: "In light of the above" = formal conclusion phrase

questions.text: "___ ___ ___ ___ that the effect sizes are too small to be clinically meaningful." (it might be argued)
questions.hint: "It might be objected that" = introducing the counter-argument charitably

questions.text: "A substantial body of research demonstrates" is more academically appropriate than "loads of research shows."
questions.hint: Register: formal academic vocabulary vs informal expression

questions.text: "The ___ of the policy was assessed over a 12-month period." (implement → noun)
"___, this represents the most significant gap in the existing literature." (it can be argued)
questions.hint: "Arguably" = this can be argued/contended (debatable but defensible claim)
